scene.ko: 테스트를 건너뛰고 출시를 앞당기자는 부장의 제안에 근거를 들어 부드럽게 반대하고 대안을 낸다.

lines.en: Our main competitor is launching next month, so I'd like to move our launch up by three weeks. I think we can skip the second round of testing.
lines.ko: 주요 경쟁사가 다음 달에 출시하니까, 우리 출시를 3주 앞당기고 싶어요. 2차 테스트는 건너뛰어도 될 것 같고요.

lines.en: I see your point, and being first to market really matters. But I'm a little concerned about skipping the testing.
lines.ko: 무슨 말씀인지 알겠어요. 시장에 먼저 나가는 게 정말 중요하죠. 그런데 테스트를 건너뛰는 건 좀 걱정돼요.
alt: I understand why that matters. Still, I'm a bit worried about skipping the second round of tests.

lines.en: Why is that? The first round went pretty well, didn't it?
It did, but we found about thirty bugs, and we haven't fixed all of them yet. If customers run into them, it could hurt our reputation.
lines.ko: 그렇긴 한데, 버그를 서른 개쯤 찾았고 아직 다 고치지 못했어요. 고객들이 그 버그를 겪으면 회사 평판에 안 좋을 수 있어요.
alt: Yes, but we found around thirty bugs, and some still aren't fixed. That could damage our reputation.

lines.en: Hmm. But if we wait, we might lose customers to them.
lines.ko: 음. 하지만 기다리다가 고객을 경쟁사에 뺏길 수도 있어요.

lines.en: That's true. Would it be possible to launch a smaller version first, with only the features we've already tested?
lines.ko: 맞는 말씀이에요. 이미 테스트를 마친 기능만 넣은 작은 버전을 먼저 출시하면 어떨까요?
alt: That's a fair point. What if we launched a lighter version first, with just the tested features?

lines.en: Interesting. How soon could we do that?
lines.ko: 흥미롭네요. 그러면 얼마나 빨리 할 수 있어요?

lines.en: I'd need to check with the developers, but I think two weeks would be realistic.
lines.ko: 개발자들에게 확인해 봐야겠지만, 2주 정도면 현실적일 것 같아요.
alt: I'll have to confirm with the developers, but about two weeks seems realistic.

lines.en: All right. Can you put together a plan by Thursday?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 목요일까지 계획을 정리해 줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. I'll send you a draft on Wednesday so we have time to discuss it.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 함께 논의할 시간이 있도록 수요일에 초안을 보내 드릴게요.
alt: Of course. I'll send you a draft by Wednesday so we can talk it over.
